prompt:
Redraw the attached flat face map from scratch as an AUTHENTIC 1999 PLAYSTATION 1 HUMAN HEAD DIFFUSE, like a close-up of the actual in-game Harry Mason face texture from Silent Hill 1. Keep this specific young man's identity: thick nearly straight dark eyebrows with a central gap, almond hazel-brown eyes, slim straight nose, thin sparse moustache, sparse small pointed chin goatee, thin closed lips. Neutral relaxed expression. This is a single neutral texture, no alternate expressions.

The attached source was REJECTED because it looks like a smooth modern portrait with a pixel effect. Radically simplify the drawing: use an apparent 64 by 64 pixel working canvas enlarged by nearest-neighbor. The face should really have only about 64 texels across, not hundreds of small noisy blocks. Broad, deliberate, irregular painted light/shadow clusters, approximately 24–32 total muted colors; only 6–8 skin colors. Eyebrows are roughly 12 by 2–3 texels each; a pupil is around 2 texels; moustache built from a few short dark texel clusters. No tiny individual hair strands, no pores, no freckle noise, no painted acne spots, no soft airbrush, no glossy skin, no portrait photo detail. Keep an anatomical human semi-realistic PS1 face, not a 2D RPG sprite or cartoon. Restrained old-console dithering in a few shade transitions, chunky visible square pixels. Slightly gritty hand-painted Silent Hill 1 character texture. Light-medium olive beige skin, much less orange/yellow than the source; youthful, not aged, no bags under the eyes.

OUTPUT: ONLY ONE perfectly frontal FLAT SQUARE UV DIFFUSE MAP, edge-to-edge flesh colors, with the facial features drawn in it. No head silhouette or oval mask; no edges, no border, no background, no ears, neck, shirt, cap, hairline, text, arrows, UV lines, other views, or 3D model. Skin-color regions must reach all four edges. Leave the perimeter as simple low-contrast skin with NO features near the edges, so it can wrap around cheeks and neck. Minimal shadow on the nose because there is already 3D nose geometry.

VERY IMPORTANT MAP PLACEMENT as percentages of the entire square: pupil centers at (30%,28%) and (70%,28%); eyebrows y=17%; nose tip centered at y=50%; nostril marks y=54%; thin moustache y=64%; closed mouth center at (50%,70%), width 34%; small chin goatee at (50%,88%) not touching the bottom edge. Top 10% is plain forehead skin with no hair. Keep all major features and dark facial hair at least 8% away from canvas edges. Paint it as if it were a genuinely tiny texture extracted from a PS1 game.
